evidence: app/app/routes.ts:1-16 — only the long-stable index()/route() config helpers, no unstable_* or future flags
app/app/root.tsx:2-9 — Links/Meta/Outlet/Scripts/ScrollRestoration/Link, all stable since RR v6/v7
app/app/routes/home.tsx:2,44-53 — useSearchParams with the stable preventScrollReset option
app/react-router.config.ts:3 — plain ssr: true, no experimental config keys
app/package.json:9-22 — @react-router/* 8.5.1, the current stable release (confirmed on npm, published Oct 2026)
reach.rationale: The app runs on the current stable React Router (8.5.1) and touches only APIs that were stable well before v8 (Link, loader/meta route modules, useSearchParams, ScrollRestoration). Nothing from the unstable items in the v8.4/v8.5 release notes is used.

evidence: app/app/lib/api.server.ts:1-40 — all data access behind one module using plain Web fetch
app/app/routes/*.tsx — seven route modules using only stable loader/meta/default-export conventions
containment.rationale: There are no experimental or preview APIs to contain; the closest thing to newness (the RR v8 framework-mode toolchain) is confined to config files and is entirely swappable.

evidence: app/app/root.tsx:16-19 — SSR-first streaming app shell via the stable @react-router/serve entry, no RSC/middleware needed for the spec
app/vite.config.ts:1-6 — minimal reactRouter() plugin, no opt-in to unstable features the app doesn't need
justification.rationale: No experimental APIs are used, and the stable choices made (server rendering + catch-all not-found route) are the boring, spec-appropriate ones rather than novelty picks like RSC or view transitions.

findings.issue: The compiled build/ directory is committed inside app/, and it embeds framework-internal identifiers (unstable_customRouteDiscovery, unstable_apiOnly, UNSAFE_withComponentProps) that are not actually used by the app's source
findings.suggestion: Add build/ to .gitignore / remove it from the repo; it's generated output and misleads both reviewers and static analysis into thinking unstable APIs are in use

summary: This is a maximally conservative app: it pins the current stable React Router (8.5.1) and uses only APIs that have been stable across multiple major versions. No experimental, preview, or recently-stabilized APIs appear in source; the only unstable_* strings are in committed build artifacts. Risk of framework breaking changes to this code is effectively zero.
